name: agentcraft-genesis-dependency-baseline

openbot.package_manifest_observed: Bun 1.3.14; Playwright Core 1.62.1 (per founding architecture baseline)
openbot.integration_rule: thin HTTP/protocol adapters only; no private workspace imports; never restructure upstream

runtime_integration.boundary: documented agent-computer HTTP API: /health, /exec, /files/write, /files/read, /files/list, /files/download, /computers, /computers/stop, /computers/reset; bearer COMPUTER_TOKEN + x-openbot-bot-id header

runtime_integration.deployment_mode: process-per-worker where no container runtime exists (EGRESS_POLICY_REQUIRED=0 per v0.1.0 release notes for computers run without the API server); supervisor containers remain the canonical mode on Docker-capable infrastructure
runtime_integration.supervisor_api_observed: POST /computers/:botId/ensure|stop|reset, GET /computers, GET /health — verified from source at tag v0.1.0; not exercised (no container runtime in sandbox); drop-in behind the same RuntimeAdapter boundary

openmuse.integration_rule: reuse durable-work patterns (jobs, plans, checkpoints, leases, retries, action receipts); no vendor dump

opendots.integration_rule: reference for specialist worker patterns; deferred capabilities are not MVP requirements

copilotkit-intelligence.integration_rule: reuse threads/memory/channels/automatic learning; no parallel thread or memory engine
